implementation_notes: A distributable package per context, with `__init__.py` re-exports as the surface. Enforce with import-linter contracts or a layering test in CI; keep cross-context knowledge in a separate contract package rather than importing another context's internals.
code_sketch:
# pyproject.toml (import-linter)
[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "Orders must not reach into billing internals"
source_modules = ["orders"]
forbidden_modules = ["billing.internal"]
pitfalls: A monorepo with no import rules, so any module imports any other
Contexts sharing a `models.py` that both import — the classic implicit merge
